name: Doutei Soushitsu wa Shinjin Kyoushi de
original_name: 童貞喪失は新人教師で
source:
A new teacher is filling in for the main teacher's
maternity leave. She's smart and beautiful... after school
the virgin protagonist who has a crush on her lays
it all bare: "I want to lose my virginity to you."
Will she let him?

A multi-ending student-teacher ADV game!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ090667.html/?]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一位新老师代替休产假的班主任来上课。她聪明又美丽……放学后，暗恋她的处男主人公鼓起勇气全盘托出：“我想把童贞献给你。”她会答应他吗？

一款多结局的师生ADV游戏！
